description: This file defines the ActivationRebalancerOptions class, which contains configuration options for activation rebalancing in Orleans, including parameters like rebalancer timing, entropy thresholds, and weights for migration policies. It also includes a validator class for these options.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerOptions
classes.description: A sealed class encapsulating configuration options for activation rebalancing, including timing, entropy, and migration parameters.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerOptionsValidator
classes.description: An internal sealed class responsible for validating the correctness of ActivationRebalancerOptions and DeploymentLoadPublisherOptions.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the ActivationRebalancerOptions instance, ensuring parameters like SessionCyclePeriod, MaxStagnantCycles, EntropyQuantum, and others are within acceptable ranges.
